summary: Cartesian Growth Corp III (CGCT) filed an 8-K announcing that its registration statement on Form S-4 with Factorial Inc., a solid-state battery leader, was declared effective on May 6, 2026, and its extraordinary general meeting will be held on May 27, 2026 to approve the business combination. The filing updates on the de-SPAC merger timeline. No deal terms are stated in this filing (stake, price, premium, advisors). The announcement moves the SPAC combination forward toward shareholder vote. What to watch: the meeting date results and potential redemptions, as SPAC merger arb depends on approval and trust balance post-redemption.
